messages:
peggy: quick FYI i'm opening a docs PR to harmonize header names across pricing, quotas, and dashboards, and to fix the "Spend by tenant" grafana panel which currently shows hourly spikes that confuse customers. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6299

samir: nice. which header are we standardizing on? we've used X-Usage-Tier, X-Quota-Tier, X-Cost-Tier in different spots.

peggy: proposing `X-Cost-Tier` as canonical in pricing docs, `X-Quota-Tier` remains in quota pages for clarity (we'll add cross-refs). the API will continue accepting old names. docs will show curl/node/go examples with `X-Cost-Tier`.

jane: for the grafana change what's the exact query diff? ops needs the UID for migration.

peggy: switching panel query from `sum(billing.cost_hour)` to `sum by (tenant) (rate(billing.cost_seconds[1m])) * 60` so it shows cost-per-minute per tenant. migration UID: G-spend77. added a one-line rationale: per-minute smooths spikes and aligns with billing exports better.

samir: can you add a small Go snippet too? partners often ask for Go examples. keep it tiny.

peggy: added Go and curl snippets. Go example below: 
```
// go (net/http)
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"model":"open-7b","input":"Cost summary"}`))
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
req.Header.Set("X-Cost-Tier", "enterprise")
resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
```

qa: please ensure snippet-tests include header assertions; our HTTP fixtures have failed before when header names changed.

peggy: noted. updated fixtures and test harness. ops-bot will re-run checks.

ops-bot: running lint, link-check and snippet-tests on PR #6299.

ops-bot: snippet-tests failed: recorded fixture expected header `X-Usage-Tier`. please update recording.

peggy: updated the failing fixture and re-recorded the snippet. pushed fix.

ops-bot: all checks passed at 5032104605. merging after docs site rebuild.

jane: thanks — i'll add a migration note in the dashboard docs: "If you copied the panel before 2026-05-01, replace `sum(billing.cost_hour)` with `sum by (tenant) (rate(billing.cost_seconds[1m])) * 60` and update title to 'Cost per minute by tenant'."

samir: small follow-up: add a short FAQ bullet clarifying that the API accepts legacy header names for backward compat but recommends `X-Cost-Tier` going forward.

peggy: added FAQ and cross-ref entries. i'll post a short announcement in #docs once the site rebuilds. closing thread.
